newsitem.title: USA: Dailey calls off merger with Phoenix.
newsitem.headline: Dailey calls off merger with Phoenix.

text.p: Dailey Petroleum Services Corp. said Tuesday it has agreed to terminate an agreement to acquire Phoenix Drilling Services Inc. for $67 million in cash.

A Dailey spokeswoman said the two companies were unable to come to final terms on the deal, which was announced last month, following completion of due diligence. She declined to offer further specifics.
Dailey, based in Conroe, Texas, provides oil and gas drilling services.
Its stock rose 25 cents to $7 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
